Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Lambach wrote:
>
> Is the basic damage of an ally considered "Hand Damage"? What happens
> when a Garou strikes with a Meat Cleaver?

If it is non-ranged, yes. "Hand Damage" is damage from a hand strike.
And:

* Hand Strike: any non-ranged, non-weapon strike that deals damage based
on the striking minion's hand damage, or any minion's non-ranged
damage-dealing innate strike. [LSJ 970224]

> when a Garou strikes with a Meat Cleaver?

He does 2+1 = 3 damage (not hand damage, since the strike is not a
hand strike).
